context: Two layers. Downstream: _sanitize_applied_receipt pops receipt['error'] (replace with error_redacted:true) and redacts entries[].reason unless it matches a known code-authored template. Upstream (the durable fix): stop interpolating raw exception text and parsed table identifiers into reason - carry a stable code-token reason (e.g. 'introspection_degraded', 'absent_in_catalog') plus a detail field that is already on the drop list. Extend the same policy to dropped[] (scrub or enforce the convention with a lint/test). Add the missing test coverage: the existing test (tests/unit/core/results/test_applied_ledger_export.py:109-159) never exercises a receipt.
description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review (leak demonstrated by executing the real scrub code).

Leak 1: IntrospectionReceipt.to_payload() emits a top-level 'error' (benchbox/core/tuning/introspection.py:211-212), and every degraded entry gets reason=f'introspection degraded: {state_error}' (introspection.py:531) where state_error embeds the raw driver exception from the platform introspectors (clickhouse/introspection.py:78, duckdb_introspection.py:61, snowflake_introspection.py:99) - connection strings, hostnames, usernames, cert paths. _sanitize_applied_receipt (benchbox/core/results/exporter.py:478-503) pops statement/diff/evidence/table/name/columns but never receipt['error'], and deliberately retains 'reason' (docstring wrongly classifies reason as structural). After ResultExporter(anonymize=True) the 'anonymized' companion still contains the full raw driver string in applied_receipt.receipt.error and entries[].reason - next to statement_redacted:true.

Leak 2: ABSENT verdicts set reason=f'no {intent.kind} on {intent.table} found in catalog' (introspection.py:553); intent.table is captured by [^\s(]+ regexes so it carries fully-qualified catalog.schema.table - the exact identifier class the exporter pops from the sibling 'table' field.

Propagation: the explorer pipeline ingests the receipt verbatim (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py:303-332), RunReceipt.tsx:371 renders reason, and publish/submit copy companions byte-for-byte (benchbox/validation/bundle.py COMPANION_SUFFIXES, cli/commands/submit.py:665-667), so export-time scrubbing is the only gate. Contradicts the design note's own claim at docs/development/tuning-introspection-receipts.md:136-137 ('Anonymized exports scrub the receipt's free-text / identifier fields exactly like the ledger statements').

Adjacent smell (fix here too): dropped[].intent/reason are retained wholesale on an unenforced 'code-authored strings' convention (exporter.py:424-426); today's call sites are safe (duckdb.py:1360-1376) but nothing stops a future adapter passing exception text into record_dropped.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not fix by dropping the receipt entirely from anonymized exports
anti_patterns.instead: scrub the free-text fields and keep the structured verdicts
anti_patterns.why: the receipt is the corroboration evidence and the whole point of the feature

anti_patterns.dont: Do not regex-redact hostnames/paths out of the raw error string
anti_patterns.instead: replace free text with code tokens and *_redacted markers, keeping raw detail only in fields already dropped
anti_patterns.why: denylist scrubbing of arbitrary driver text is unwinnable; the exporter's model is field-drop, not content-filtering

anti_patterns.dont: Do not weaken the existing statement/table/evidence drops while refactoring
anti_patterns.instead: extend the drop list; never shrink it
anti_patterns.why: they are the currently-working half of the policy, pinned by tests

preserves.behavior: Non-anonymized exports keep full statement/error/reason text - the honest local record must not lose diagnostics.
Receipt structure stays backward-compatible for the explorer's verbatim ingestion (additive markers only, no renamed fields).
The upgrade gate's fail-closed behavior on degraded introspection is unchanged; only the TEXT carried in the receipt changes.
Verdicts, summary counts, and the corroborated flag are untouched by scrubbing - anonymization must never change trust semantics.
